scripts.text:
[Laertes]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Creamys?
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
你猎杀够50只克瑞米了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放弃

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
嗯，你好像还没猎杀够50只...

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
Remember, I need help hunting Creamys so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
记住，我需要你帮忙猎杀克瑞米，去杀够50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
确定要放弃狩猎吗？
目前的任务进度都会清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
好吧，改变主意了就回来找我。

scripts.text:

Please kill 50 Creamys.
scripts.translation:

请猎杀50只克瑞米。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

[Laertes]
I work for an apothecary in Prontera.
I come here to collect materials for medicine.
scripts.translation:

我在普隆德拉的一家药店干活，来这里收集制药材料。

scripts.text: What did you need?

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
Hey, thank you again.
Here you go, as promised.
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]

来，这是答应给你的东西。

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
It doesn't look like you have enough.
scripts.translation:

看来你带来的还不够。

scripts.text:

I will give you some medical supplies.
scripts.translation:
